items.html: Also, "Ester" has the gematria of 661. And the name Adonai in its full spelling is 671. And the name Esther is missing a yud, and within it is hidden the innermost point itself, called the yud of Adonai, called Esther, because she is hidden. (Up to here reached the discourses of the Rav, may his memory be blessed. And the matter of sending portions, man to his friend, was not explained from the mouth of the Rav, may his memory be blessed; and perhaps it hints at the matter of the illumination of the Yesod of the male that is given to the Yesod of the female, and they are called "man to his friend" — Yesod to Yesod, as it seems to me. A.S. — Up to here reached all the book of discourses of the Rav, of blessed and holy memory, and I did not let fall a single one of his words to the ground; may his soul be bound in the bundle of life.)
